change.description: Reuse verified Playbook catalog and search bytes when validating retained editions during frozen product preflight, and carry the verifier fix through recovery tooling.
change.release_unit_description: static frontend and full-feature Docker image

planned.reasoning: The verifier still checks every retained file and manifest digest; it now supplies those already-verified bytes to the legacy projection validator so historical editions can pass preflight without changing published data or runtime APIs.

evidence.command: The verifier passes the bytes it has already checked to validatePlaybookEdition

current.reasoning: The change is limited to release-time retained Playbook validation and the compatibility copy used by frozen preflight. Manifest hashes, edition identities, public route data, and persistent state remain unchanged.

evidence.command: The recovery workflow copies the current verifier before frozen preflight

scope_drift.description: Only the retained Playbook verifier and its recovery-tooling witness changed.

verified.reasoning: Focused workflow and formatting checks pass. The verifier preserves strict file and manifest checks while satisfying the legacy validator with the exact bytes it already authenticated; no public payload or durable state contract changes.

evidence.command: Recovery copies the fixed verifier into the source checkout before preflight
Release-time validation only; published API response shapes are unchanged

persistent_state.state_description: The change does not write or migrate SQLite, reader sessions, comments, release ledger state, or Playbook edition identity bytes.

evidence.command: The workflow only selects release-time source files for preflight
